verdict.rationale: Slate's docs describe queueing a message to run after the current turn, running background subagents, and built-in workflow programs like `goal` and `deep-research`. These are one-off or in-session sequencing features, not recurring schedules. Nothing in the evidence shows cron-style or time-based recurring job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
